result.summary: The layout is mostly sound, but the 'Popular right now' card has a clipped restaurant title colliding with the rating, and the favourite heart buttons are styled inconsistently between cards.

issues.description: The restaurant name in the first 'Popular right now' card is cut off ('Tokumaru Ramei' instead of 'Tokumaru Ramen') because the title row does not leave room for the rating block on the right; the text runs into/behind the star rating.
issues.suggestion: Make the title flexible with proper truncation (ellipsis) and give the rating a fixed, non-shrinking width with a gap so the name is never clipped mid-character.

issues.description: The favourite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different styles: the first has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, the second has a dark circular background with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favourite button style (single background/icon treatment, or a consistent contrast rule) across all cards.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first card's image has a light grey background while the neighbouring cards use dark photographic backgrounds, making the row look visually inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent image treatment/aspect and background for all carousel thumbnails, or apply a uniform overlay so badges read consistently.
